summary.summary:
・體育熱潮橫掃搜尋榜，英格蘭與巴基斯坦的第二場測試賽因天色昏暗在第一天暫停，而巴塞隆納則以 2-0 擊敗畢爾包並登上西甲積分榜首位。
・巴基斯坦板球運動員艾曼·安韋爾在經歷 6 年的國際賽生涯後宣布退役，並將開啟比賽裁判的新篇章。
・由 Mahira Khan 與 Wahaj Ali 主演的新電視劇《Mitti De Baway》釋出預告片，引發網路上大量關注與討論。
・尼泊爾中部與西藏發生致命洪災與土石流，造成嚴重死傷，且仍有上千人失蹤，引發國際媒體高度關注。
・車路士在比賽中以 2-0 擊敗盧頓，相關賽事精華與球員動態成為球迷討論焦點。
summary.summaryEn:
・Sports dominated the searches as the 2nd Test between England and Pakistan was halted due to bad light on Day 1, while Barcelona defeated Athletic Bilbao 2-0 to top the Spanish League standings.
・Pakistani cricketer Aiman Anwer announced her retirement from international cricket after six years, stepping into a new chapter as a match referee.
・The upcoming drama Mitti De Baway generated massive online buzz following the release of its trailer featuring Mahira Khan and Wahaj Ali.
・Deadly floods and landslides struck central Nepal and Tibet, causing severe casualties and leaving over a thousand people missing.
・Chelsea secured a 2-0 victory against Luton Town, with match highlights and player transfer news driving high search interest.
